articles.title: Clarity odds jump to 43% on Polymarket after unverified reports Trump agreed to ethics deal
articles.snippet: Bettors moved the crypto market structure bill to a 43% chance of passing this year, up from a record low last week, though no bill text has appeared.

articles.title: Base’s 1:1-backed tokenized equities launch ‘imminent,’ Pollak says
articles.snippet: The Coinbase-backed Ethereum layer-2 is preparing to expand its financial offerings as it pivots away from its earlier social-first strategy.

articles.title: Patrick Witt defers military training as CLARITY heads to Senate
articles.snippet: The decision keeps the administration’s chief crypto policy negotiator in place during what could be a decisive few weeks for the CLARITY Act.

articles.title: Pakistan Launches Crypto Investigation Unit to Fight Money Laundering
articles.snippet: Islamabad is building the enforcement side of its crypto push, standing up a unit to police money laundering even as it licenses exchanges.

articles.title: ECB Warns Stablecoins May Drain Bank Deposits—Here's What That Means
articles.snippet: ECB board member Piero Cipollone laid out the three-layer threat banks face from digital payments, and pitched the digital euro as the only structural answer.
